costBasis: Per-instance cost averaged within each scenario, then across the four scenarios; not actual billing. Subscription-plan runs (Claude, GPT, Gemini) are the run's API-equivalent USD times the efficiency ratio E of its plan category, in Claude API dollars (taskPoints); the rest in USD

instanceCost.deepseek: Benchmark instance cost.usd: per-request official price list, peak / off-peak by request time
instanceCost.anthropic: Benchmark instance cost.usd (Claude Code total_cost_usd, API-equivalent USD) times the Claude plan's E (1 by definition); equivalent task points = result / taskPoints.pointUsd
instanceCost.openai: Token counts priced at the rates below (API-equivalent USD) times the Codex plan's E; equivalent task points = result / taskPoints.pointUsd
instanceCost.strata: Local running cost from the instance work seconds and the localRunningCost settings below
instanceCost.google: Token counts priced at the rates below (output includes thinking; API-equivalent USD) times Gemini's estimated E; equivalent task points = result / taskPoints.pointUsd. The benchmark ran on a Google plan login

strata-iq3_xxs.notes: Home PC with an RTX 3080 Ti 12 GB, i9-13900 and 64 GB RAM. 400 W is a rough whole-system load estimate (350 W GPU board limit; memory-bound decoding usually draws less). Electricity is the Q1 2026 world household average (country-weighted). Maintenance covers wear parts at about USD 50 a year over about 2,500 loaded hours.

taskPoints.pointUsdSource: TASK_POINT_USD in ~/.claude/lib/conversion.py: one equivalent task point is worth $100 of Claude API (1/20 of a Max 20x weekly quota)
taskPoints.formula: cost USD = API-equivalent USD of the run x E of the plan category; equivalent task points = cost USD / pointUsd. A run's share of its plan's window times the window's API-equivalent value is the run's API-equivalent USD, so the plan size cancels and only E remains.
taskPoints.efficiencyMeaning: E = Claude's historical cost of the same kind of finished work / this plan category's cost of it (taskpts.py); the category aggregate is used for every model of the plan, not each model's own E

anthropic.source: taskpts.json scope claude (model null) on 2026-11-18 04:01; 1 by definition (coverage 80%, 28-day window)

openai.source: taskpts.json scope codex (model null) on 2026-11-18 04:01 (28-day window, 146 covered finished items); used for Sol and Luna alike, Luna's own E is hidden by the page's coverage rule

google.source: Estimate from .tasks/common/taskpts-boot-report-1116.md section 7 (Gemini aggregate, baseline weighted by Claude's real review counts: 1.19, coverage 48%; 1.08 to 1.15 under the other baselines). Below the status page's display threshold, and the Antigravity pipeline was removed on 2026-11-17, so it will not be updated.
